{{Quote|Let's see what this piece of junk can do.|Han Solo on the ''Tydirium''|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
'''''Tydirium''''' was an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]. Stolen by [[Sullustan]] [[Nien Nunb]] from the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Shieldmaiden]]'' during a diversionary mission called [[Operation Yellow Moon]] leading up to the events of the [[Battle of Endor]],<ref name="Moving Target">''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]''</ref> it was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to [[transport]] [[General]] [[Han Solo]] and his [[Special Forces Trackers Unit|strike team]] to [[Endor]] to knock out the [[Death Star's shield generator|shield generator]] that was protecting the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]].<ref name="Episode VI" />
